title: Alfredo Sauce
description: Rich, velvety, and unapologetically indulgent. A classic cream-based Alfredo that coats pasta like silk and demands to be eaten immediately.

method.instruction: Melt butter gently in a wide pan over low heat, taking care not to brown it.
Add garlic and cook briefly until fragrant, about 30 seconds.
Pour in cream and bring to a gentle simmer. Cook for 3–4 minutes until slightly thickened.
Reduce heat to low and gradually stir in Parmesan until fully melted and smooth.
Season with salt and black pepper, adjusting to taste.
Serve immediately over hot pasta, loosening with a splash of pasta water if needed.

notes.title: Serving Tip
notes.content: Best paired with fettuccine. Add grilled chicken, prawns, or mushrooms for a complete dish.

notes.title: Sauce Consistency
notes.content: If the sauce thickens too much, loosen gently with reserved pasta water rather than extra cream.
